evidence.quote: At SC26, an annual supercomputing conference taking place this week in Chicago, NVIDIA is introducing the DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit for researchers, academics and developers.
At four nodes, it provides 512GB of combined memory and 20TB of NVMe storage that provides researchers more capacity to distribute models and scientific workloads across the cluster.

title: NVIDIA DGX Spark Developer Kit Turns a Desk Into a Supercomputing Lab
displayTitle: 英伟达推出四节点 DGX Spark HPC 开发套件
summary: 英伟达介绍四节点 DGX Spark 开发套件，节点环形直连，合计 512GB 内存与 20TB 存储；HPC SDK 配置指南尚待推出。
investorNote: 桌面多节点环境有助于开发调试，但不能代替生产级集群的规模和可靠性。
